observations: White split-type air conditioner indoor unit placed on top of an outdoor condenser unit.
Both units sit on indoor tiled flooring.
The word "inverter" is visible on the lower unit's front panel.
No brand name or model number is legible in the photo.
No remote control, connecting pipes, or power cable is visible.
Units show dust and signs of use.

claims.evidence: photo cannot show an electrical or mechanical fault

risks.risk: Nature and extent of the fault
risks.proof: video of the unit running or a technician fault report

risks.risk: Whether both indoor and outdoor units plus pipes are included

risks.proof: photo of remote, pipes, and cables
clear photo of brand label or model plate

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the brand label and model plate on each unit
Video of the unit switched on showing the exact fault
Photo showing remote control, connecting pipes, and cables if included
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used inverter air conditioner in faulty condition and can be valued at worst-case non-working status; the scrap AC and working AC comparables bound the range.
